title: Optimizing Global Logistics Inventory Visibility
business: A global logistics provider managing millions of SKU movements across regional distribution centers.
problem: The company struggles with fragmented data silos where regional managers cannot perform real-time cross-region inventory analysis, leading to stock imbalances and delayed fulfillment.
solution: By centralizing logistics logs and inventory snapshots into OpenSearch, the company can utilize indexed document search to perform complex aggregations across disparate datasets, visualizing the results through OpenSearch Dashboards for unified operational oversight.
steps: Define index mappings to ensure SKU identifiers and location timestamps are indexed as searchable keywords.
Ingest real-time logistics event streams into the OpenSearch cluster using a unified index pattern.
Construct aggregation queries using the Query DSL to calculate inventory levels per region and category.
Create OpenSearch Dashboards visualizations to map inventory density and identify regional supply gaps.
Configure index lifecycle management to transition older logistics logs to cost-effective storage tiers.
outcome: The logistics team achieves a unified view of global inventory, enabling proactive stock redistribution and improved fulfillment accuracy.
limitation: The primary limitation is the resource overhead of performing deep aggregations on high-cardinality fields, which can lead to increased latency; this is checked by monitoring the search execution time in the OpenSearch slow logs.
